skill.summary: Use when the user mentions wos, WOS, WoS, or Web of Science and wants topic-based literature search, Shenzhen University library login, paper screening, abst...

latestVersion.changelog:
wos-feishu-literature 1.0.1

- Introduced a new skill for topic-driven literature search and Feishu Base writeback, triggered by "WOS", "Web of Science", etc.
- Enforces a structured workflow: asks preflight questions, prefers Shenzhen University library route, and defaults to SSCI database.
- Requires user confirmation for Feishu table details and handles multi-step authentication pauses.
- Specifies detailed rules for screening, deduplication, field extraction, and JCR Quartile lookups.
- Prioritizes local lark-cli for Feishu integration; supports both Windows and PowerShell edge cases.
